name: Wave Bye
summary: Newsletter unsubscribe with a little envelope mascot that frets, offers options, waves and walks off
about: Wave Bye is a kind, honest unsubscribe flow. Pip, a round envelope mascot, gets nervous when you hover Unsubscribe and sheds a tear on the confirm step, which also offers a monthly round-up or a four-week pause. Confirm and Pip waves goodbye and walks off with a bundle, leaving footprints; Resubscribe brings it running back with hearts.
how: Hover or focus Unsubscribe to see Pip get worried.
Press Unsubscribe and choose: stop all emails, monthly round-up or pause.
Press Confirm to apply it, or Keep weekly (Escape) to stay as you are.
Use Resubscribe, Resume now or Back to weekly to undo it.
